name: fix-objectives
about: Floor objectives (bugs 10.22.26 line 46, mods/objectives): with objectives.vaults 1 and objectives.exit on, a generated keep floor gets one loot vault (a sealed room with two chests and a nav-blocking door) whose lever sits elsewhere on the floor, and an exit switch; the floor's exit areas are disabled until it is pressed and the HUD says so. The generator logs every placement; the bot reads the positions back, proves the vault is closed (no path in) and the exits disabled, uses the vault lever (door opens, a path in, Vaults 1/1), uses the exit lever (exits enabled, 'The way down is open', then the line clears) and checks hwp objectives. Mods core + objectives. About 4 minutes.

steps.name: the module hooked the indoor dungeon generators

steps.until: \[HWP:objectives\] vault 0 at cell \d+,\d+ of \d+x\d+, corridor \d+, world -?\d+,-?\d+ \d+x\d+, door -?\d+,-?\d+, switch -?\d+,-?\d+
steps.name: a generated keep floor placed a vault with its switch
the generator placed the exit switch
the host disabled the floor's exit areas at start

steps.pattern: \[HWP:objectives\] start: 1 vault\(s\), exit switch sealed, [1-9]\d* door unit\(s\), [2-9]\d* switch unit\(s\)
steps.name: the door and both lever units constructed on this floor

steps.pattern: \[HWP:objectives\] (prefab defs missing|vault \d+: no 3x3 floor block|exit switch used at|vault switch used at)
